Hotfix Notes - November 4, 2026

Nov 04, 2026

EverQuest Legends Hotfix Notes- 11/4/2026

Gameplay

  • Fixed an issue where cooldowns for Lay on Hands and Harm Touch would trigger but not fire their ability.
  • Hailing Ollix Everling in Nektropos Castle so that you can restart The Tragic Tale of House Everling will no longer remove your access to the castle towers if you had already earned it. This fix is not retroactive, so if you have previously had access and lost it, you will need to regain that access one more time but will keep it in the future.
  • Undead NPCs in Nektropos Castle now see through normal invisibility but do not see through invisibility vs undead.
  • Living NPCs in Nektropos Castle now see through invisibility vs undead but do not see through normal invisibility.
  • Mimics in Nektropos Castle see food.
  • Shroud of Stealth is generally effective in Nektropos Castle.
  • Some rare/named creatures in Nektropos Castle are capable of seeing through all types of invisibility.
